dialogues.speaker: Jabari
dialogues.text: Answer this question real quick, would you? Fish, or meat?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll take them all.

dialogues.speaker: Jabari
dialogues.text: ...Well, that was quick.

dialogues.speaker: Jabari
dialogues.text: But unfortunately, I'm afraid that only one meat dish is permitted at a time at my family's table.

dialogues.speaker: Jabari
dialogues.text: Otherwise, my wife will talk my ear off about "earnings" and "saving Mora" all night, starting at the dinner table.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait. Fish don't count as meat?

dialogues.speaker: Jabari
dialogues.text: ...Well, that's an unexpected reply!

dialogues.speaker: Jabari
dialogues.text: Does fish count as meat? Hmm. I suppose each person might have a different answer in mind...

dialogues.speaker: Jabari
dialogues.text: But that's not the problem here. I'm just wondering what I should have for dinner.

dialogues.speaker: Jabari
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, are you hungry? Would you like to have a little something?

dialogues.speaker: Jabari
dialogues.text: I don't mean to brag, but I do make some excellent food. Drop by if you've got the time and try some!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Either?

dialogues.speaker: Jabari
dialogues.text: Hmm... Well, that's not a useful reply, but fair enough, I'll give it some more thought.

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: Hmmm. It seems that this is all the Mora I have at the moment...

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: Ugh. How am I supposed to live like this?

dialogues.speaker: Jabari
dialogues.text: Hey, hey. Relax. Relax...

dialogues.speaker: Jabari
dialogues.text: Come on now. I've done some handiwork recently and got plenty of food in return, didn't I?

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: And so what? You want us to go on living from hand to mouth like this? What are we going to do when those menial jobs stop making us Mora?

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: I'm not going to just watch that happen, unlike you!

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: *sigh* Sometimes I wonder if I'm the only one in this family who actually worries about our future here...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm alright, but my companion might be hungry.

dialogues.speaker: Jabari
dialogues.text: Ah yes, I can see how that might become a problem.

dialogues.speaker: Jabari
dialogues.text: The troubles of a teammate by your side can be even harder to handle than your own.

dialogues.speaker: Jabari
dialogues.text: Whatever the case, why don't you try some?
